articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin tumbles after blowout August jobs print
articles.snippet: Net assets in spot bitcoin ETFs crossed $103 billion for the first time, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for well over half the money.

articles.title: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf
articles.snippet: Kraken is joining SoFi's settlement network and list SoFiUSD as the companies link traditional banking with crypto markets.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin jumps above $81,000 as rates fall, dollar weakens
articles.snippet: The government's employment data (due tomorrow) is usually the main economic report of the month, but this time around it's next week's inflation numbers that will decide Fed policy.

articles.title: US law enforcement group moves to ‘neutral’ position on CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: Despite earlier opposition to the CLARITY Act over consumer protection, the National Sheriffs’ Association says it will now “step back and allow the legislative process to proceed.“

articles.title: US, UK launch joint alliance targeting crypto scam centers
articles.snippet: The agreement includes parallel investigations and information sharing, with US and UK authorities planning a private-sector disruption operation in London in October.
